INSERT INTO outfitting (
                    market_id,
                    module_name,
                    buy_price,
                    merc_coins_price,
                    listed_at)
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
                ON CONFLICT (market_id, module_name)
                DO UPDATE SET
                    buy_price = $3,
                    merc_coins_price = $4,
                    listed_at = $5
